correctness.rationale: The chain-level reduced Lefschetz sign is proved for all invariant orbit unions, with the augmented empty matching included. The five-vertex complex has 75 primitive Hasse cover pairs, and binary recursion visits all admissible fixed orbit unions. An independent full-Hasse acyclicity routine reproduces all six nonidentity character values and counts. The exact published 15-entry f-vector yields the identity 212456. The S5 Specht coefficients are exact class-size-weighted character inner products, all with integral results. Four-label exhaustive enumeration reproduces the previously published (99,1,-1,0,-1) control case. Nothing assumes unknown five-label graded homology.

value.rationale: The first full simplex dimension whose individual Morse-complex homology is computationally unresolved nonetheless has a complete exact S5-equivariant Euler representation. This natural invariant strictly refines Scoville's single Euler number and a separate optimal-matching stabilizer census, yields a 1770 rational quotient Euler characteristic, and constrains future homology computations. It is not merely a small isolated normalization check.
